title: Sakura Sakura
attribution: Edo-period koto melody, first printed in the Ministry of Education's Sokyoku-shu (1888); verse 1 is the 1941 "noyama mo sato mo" text (Uta no Hon), verse 2 the 1888 "yayoi no sora wa" text. Anonymous, public domain. The tune uses the Japanese "in" pentatonic scale (A B C E F); the F is expected to show as out-of-key.
